# RoV LAB

> RoV LAB (https://rovlab.app) is a Thai-language site for analyzing Arena of Valor (RoV) heroes, counters, drafts and builds using real game data.

## Main tools

- [Heroes](https://rovlab.app/heroes): Hero directory. Each hero has its own page at /heroes/{hero-slug}, for example https://rovlab.app/heroes/nakroth.
- [Tier List](https://rovlab.app/tier-list): Hero tier list based on game statistics.
- [Counter Pick](https://rovlab.app/counter-pick): Find heroes that counter a given hero.
- [Matchup](https://rovlab.app/matchup): Compare two heroes head to head.
- [Draft](https://rovlab.app/draft): Draft assistant for pick and ban decisions.
- [Stats](https://rovlab.app/stats): Hero statistics overview.
- [Learn](https://rovlab.app/learn): Learning resources and guides for improving at RoV.

## Policies and data

- [Data Sources](https://rovlab.app/data-sources): Where the site's game data comes from.
- [Community Guidelines](https://rovlab.app/community-guidelines): Rules for community features.
- [Disclaimer](https://rovlab.app/disclaimer): Usage disclaimer.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rovlab.app/privacy): How user data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://rovlab.app/terms): Terms of use.

- [Sitemap](https://rovlab.app/sitemap.xml): Full list of public pages, including every hero page.
